about.en: G Coin (GCOIN) is the token of Playnance, an on-chain gaming and prediction ecosystem whose games and sports events settle on Playblock, Playnance's Layer 3 chain built with Arbitrum Orbit. Per the issuer's whitepaper the token is an ERC-20-compatible contract at 0xC3B539972C522d883aaA904aAAdcfE69A2d9F26B on Playblock (chain id 1829), where it reads symbol G, name G Coin and 9 decimals. It is unrelated to the Galaxy Fight Club GCOIN token on Polygon.
